questions.question: At the city gate, Boaz told a relative he could buy Naomi's family land. What else must the man do on that day?

answers.text: Acquire the widow of the deceased
Pay the debts of the deceased
Repair the house of the deceased

questions.question: Why did the relative of Naomi's late husband say he could not redeem the family land?

answers.text: It would jeopardize his own inheritance
He could not afford the price Naomi was asking
He already had too many fields to work
